caption: Limfjord Bridge, Nørresundby
composition: Closed steel bascule bridge from the north bank · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Nørresundby promenade, Limfjordsbroen runs south as a low grey plate-girder bridge, the bascule leaves closed and flat, with dark water underneath and ordinary town lights on the far bank. The promenade is empty. The night is overcast, about 12.0°C. The cloud deck hides the moon, and a few lamps carry the light. There is no arch and no suspension cable.
